## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe what users experienced and what this change makes possible.

## Verification

State the checks actually run, relevant results, and anything not verified. Include a synthetic/public reproduction when practical.

## Scientific implications

If applicable, explain effects on processing state, gates, event counts, denominators, normalization, statistical assumptions, or validation claims. Link supporting evidence.

## Documentation

List user-facing guide or configuration changes. Keep raw study data, identifiers, credentials and generated results out of the pull request.
